tagline.en_US: Manage cameras and integrate video devices with Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Alexa and Home Assistant from one self-hosted platform.

description.en_US: Scrypted is a high performance home video integration platform and network video recorder with smart detections. It enables low-latency video streaming to ecosystem platforms including Apple HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa. The system works with most security cameras to bridge video feeds across smart home environments.
